items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Erstausstattung benefit
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 10.04.2026, no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date, so posting day = 10.04.2026. Jobcenter is a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, so the 4-day delivery fiction applies and (per the specific rule for job centers) the delivery day is NOT moved even if it falls on a weekend or holiday. Counting 4 days from the posting day (day of posting not counted): 11.04 (Sat, day1), 12.04 (Sun, day2), 13.04 (Mon, day3), 14.04 (Tue, day4) → deemed delivery = Tue 14.04.2026. One-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) runs from the day after delivery; under §§ 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB it ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 14.05.2026. That day (Thu 14.05.2026) is Ascension Day (Christi Himmelfahrt, a nationwide public holiday, since Easter Sunday 2026 falls on 05.04.2026 and Ascension is 39 days later). Since only the end of the period moves for a Widerspruch (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X), the deadline shifts to the next working day: Friday 15.05.2026.
